items.name: custos
items.one_liner_en: Local daemon that holds your keys, runs your strategies, and reports signed execution facts. Runs on your machine; never hosted by the Guild.
items.one_liner_zh: 跑在你机器上的守护进程,本地持交易所密钥、跑经过回测的策略,并签名上报执行事实。永不托管于云端。

entities.description_en: The legal entities of The Alephain Guild and the sites that represent them.

items.name: The Alephain Guild
items.tagline_en: translators and explorers of the market's Aleph
items.tagline_zh: 市场阿莱夫的译者与探索者
items.one_liner_en: Translating the market's infinite chaos into finite, actionable alpha through mathematics and computation.
items.one_liner_zh: 以严谨的数学与计算,将市场的无限混沌翻译为可理解、可操作的有限阿尔法。

items.name: Alchymia Labs
items.one_liner_en: The Guild's research arm. Converts market chaos into deployable strategy through mathematical modeling and statistical adjudication.
items.one_liner_zh: Guild 的研究臂。以数学建模与统计裁决,将市场混沌转化为可部署的策略。

items.name: Tesseract Trading
items.one_liner_en: The Guild's execution arm. Trades the geometry that ordinary participants cannot see.
items.one_liner_zh: Guild 的执行臂。交易普通参与者看不见的几何结构。

public_copy_rules.en: custos is never hosted by the Guild. Everyone runs their own custos on their own machine. This is the non-custodial commitment, and it is safe to state plainly.
public_copy_rules.zh: custos 永远不由 Guild 托管。每个使用者都在自己的机器上跑 custos。这是 non-custodial 承诺的基石,可以明确对外陈述。

public_copy_rules.en: Describe what a reader can rely on, not how it is delivered. How the work is divided behind the product surface is not public, and naming the parts discloses the division.
public_copy_rules.zh: 描述读者可以依赖什么,不描述它由什么构成。产品面之后的分工不对外,点名各部分即暴露了分工。

public_copy_rules.en: Public copy must not claim capabilities that are not yet operating. Roadmaps belong in conversations with prospects, not on the site.
public_copy_rules.zh: 公开文案不得宣称尚未运行的能力。路线图属于与潜在客户的对话,不属于站点。

public_copy_rules.en: Draw public copy from what a user can see: the product's own surface, its public documentation, the actions a user can take. Internal documents may be used to check a fact, never as the shape of the story.
public_copy_rules.zh: 对外文案取材于用户可见的产品面、公开文档与用户可执行的操作。内部文档只可用于核实事实,不得作为叙事骨架。
